title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Senior Legal Counsel Main responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English ; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors .
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions , especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties , state‑owned entities , or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance .
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What success looks like in this role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

description:

Role Title: Director, Programs

Contract Type: Regular (8 year Opportunity)

Reporting To: LAC Managing Director, Programs

Program: Programs

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Bogota, Mexico City

Team Name: Democratic Openings in Latin America and Caribbean

Opportunity description

This work will focus on promoting and safeguarding inclusive democratic governance in Latin America and the Caribbean. The effort will identify, develop, and support regional and national efforts to advance democracy.

Role Purpose

Directors are highly accomplished, well-networked in their field, and bring deep experience in their geographic and/or thematic area of specialty. Director of Programs oversee individual Opportunities, these are timebound programs designed to solve complex problems central to our strategic direction, for their duration and are accountable for delivering on its outcomes as well as for the management of their teams at the highest level of professionalism.

Key Responsibilities

As Director of Programs, you will:

  • Accountable for articulating a creative and exciting opening to make impact in the world into a workable project plan for implementation according to established criteria
  • Evaluate an Opportunity based on established metrics for MEL and ability to pivot to ensure the required outcomes are being achieved
  • Ensure appropriate financial, risk, and legal management and control are articulated during the planning and implementation phase, and work with all relevant stakeholders to develop mitigation plans
  • Oversee and manage the Opportunity team, including external partners
  • Engage with embedded staff from other OSF teams in close cooperation with senior leaders
  • Articulate budgetary and workforce needs for an Opportunity leveraging internal and external resources, as required
  • Monitor and regularly report on the progress of an Opportunity to the Managing Director of Programs and other senior OSF leaders
  • Leverage OSF’s work globally and employing the strategic capabilities of impact investment, strategic litigation, and advocacy to the Opportunity
  • Represent the given Opportunity and organization externally at all levels, and grow a network accordingly that includes actors beyond the social sector into national and local governments, multilateral organizations, faith-based groups, grass-roots organizations, philanthropy, local experts, academia and think tanks, etc. to advance the Opportunity. Depending on the Opportunity this might include developing strong relationships with other funders and bringing them as partners into the Opportunity
  • Travel is . Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.
People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)

Yes

Key internal relationships

Program Teams; Managing Director Programs; Managing Director Core Partner (+ teams); Grants Management; Advocacy; SEDF; Comms; Strategic Litigation; Operations; OGC & Risk

Key external relationships

External partners, public and private sector leaders

The ideal candidate
  • Prior experience in leading social change and system- change work in civil society, government, multilateral institutions, and/or the private sector that has resulted in positive societal impact
  • Extensive expertise in the specific topic area as set out in the “Opportunity Description” above
  • Prior financial ($20m+), legal and risk accountability at large-scale programmatic level
  • Network across the social sector in national and local governments, multilateral organizations, faith-based groups, grass-roots organizations, philanthropy, local experts, academia, and think tanks
  • Proven people management experience (of individual contributors and external partners)
  • Prior experience leading programmatic or organizational level change within organizations and/or systems that have gone through significant transformation
  • Experience in multiple sectors and knowledge of philanthropic tools such as advocacy and communication, strategic litigation, and social impact approaches
  • Ability to design and plan complex programs/opportunities involving cross collaboration and articulating the time, budget, stakeholder and success measures
  • Skilled in building strategic external partnerships that promote OSF’s interests and align to its strategic objectives
  • Able to nurture relationships with external partners whilst exercising considerable discretion
  • Skilled in drafting and managing a proposal development process
  • Knowledge of grant making best practices and the field of philanthropy
  • Ability to build synergies, strengthen movements, and identify and fill capacity gaps across fields
  • Demonstrate care and concern about partner organizations and the people who work in them
Languages
  • Fluency in English and Spanish
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is an asset
What we offer

  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.

  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:

  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements

  • Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution).

  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.

  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.

  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.

Who we are

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Additional information

Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

Competitive rates of pay apply.

Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities.

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is a trusted partner in risk assessment, delivering data-driven solutions that help businesses accelerate growth, enhance operational efficiency, and improve customer experience.

Our Business Services portfolio supports critical areas such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), Identity Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk Mitigation, and Customer Data Management.

Learn more at risk.lexisnexis.com.

You’ll work within a collaborative and supportive environment to grow your personal and problem-solving skills and help deliver solutions that will go head-to-head against some of the most motivated attackers in the world to protect billions in revenue.

About The Role

Collaborate with customers and account managers to maximize the value of the world’s leading email-based risk assessment solution, driving reduced fraud, lower friction, and increased profitability.

Key responsibilities include proactive account analysis, optimization of risk strategies, and delivering strategic insights during business reviews. The role requires a consultative mindset, strong analytical skills, and a focus on delivering measurable customer value.

You’ll work with real-time digital identity intelligence, analyzing millions of transactions monthly across major players in Financial Services, Insurance, and e-Commerce.

Responsibilities
  • Partner with clients to assess business needs and define project scope, objectives, and deliverables.
  • Lead project planning, execution, and governance, ensuring timelines, KPIs, and quality standards are met.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by proactively understanding client environments and delivering tailored solutions.
  • Coordinate with Product, Sales, and internal teams to ensure seamless implementation, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct workshops, manage stakeholder communication, and maintain accurate project documentation.
  • Share best practices, deliver internal training, and contribute to process optimization within Professional Services.
  • Drive customer success by fostering adoption, monitoring health metrics, and identifying upsell opportunities.
  • Gather client feedback to inform product development and enhance the overall customer experience.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in IT or equivalent experience in payments, fraud, risk management or e-commerce industry.
  • 5+ years of client-facing experience, with a strong focus on risk mitigation strategies.
  • Proven track record in account management, client delivery, and complex project implementations.

Join Howard University and thrive with us! Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities Executive Strategy & Leadership Support
  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.
Institutional Coordination & Governance
  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.
Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)
  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.
Communications & Special Projects
  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

description:
Sobre a Vaga

A Stays está entrando em um novo ciclo de crescimento acelerado, com foco em expansão internacional e evolução dos seus canais de aquisição e geração de receita. Com mais de 75.000 propriedades conectadas, presença em mais de 20 países e parcerias com os principais players globais do setor, o próximo desafio é transformar esse crescimento em um modelo cada vez mais previsível, escalável e eficiente. Buscamos um(a) Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) para liderar essa evolução — conectando marketing, vendas, parcerias e expansão internacional em uma única estratégia de crescimento. Essa é uma cadeira com impacto direto na estratégia da empresa, responsável por estruturar e escalar a nossa máquina de aquisição em um contexto de crescimento e complexidade crescentes.

Rio de Janeiro | Híbrido | CLT | Idiomas: Inglês e/ou Espanhol fluente (preferencialmente ambos)

Principais responsabilidades
  • Definir e liderar a estratégia comercial global da empresa, integrando marketing, vendas, parcerias e expansão internacional em uma única alavanca de crescimento
  • Liderar estrategicamente as áreas de Marketing, Inside Sales, Outbound Sales, Parcerias e Expansão Internacional, garantindo alinhamento, integração e eficiência entre os times
  • Definir diretrizes e acompanhar a evolução da eficiência dos canais de aquisição e do funil comercial
  • Desenvolver e escalar parcerias estratégicas e novos modelos de geração de receita dentro do ecossistema da empresa
  • Liderar a estratégia de entrada e crescimento em novos mercados internacionais, adaptando o go-to-market por país e região
  • Liderar a evolução da estratégia de monetização e modelos comerciais, em conjunto com Produto e Finanças
  • Colaborar com Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que o posicionamento de mercado e a evolução da plataforma caminhem juntos
Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha
  • Experiência sólida liderando operações comerciais em empresas B2B SaaS
  • Histórico comprovado de crescimento e escala, na prática: você já montou e acelerou motores de aquisição antes
  • Forte domínio de métricas SaaS: CAC, LTV, MRR, ARPU, NRR e afins são o seu vocabulário natural
  • Experiência liderando múltiplos canais de aquisição simultaneamente
  • Capacidade analítica real — você toma decisões com base em dados, não em feeling
  • Inglês e/ou espanhol fluente
Será um diferencial
  • Experiência com expansão internacional, especialmente em mercados da América Latina
  • Background no mercado de hospedagem, turismo ou proptech

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;

  • Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos;

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

O Supervisor de Mecânica será responsável por planejar, coordenar e supervisionar todas as atividades de manutenção mecânica a bordo da plataforma de petróleo, garantindo a confiabilidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos ativos, em conformidade com os requisitos de segurança, meio ambiente e desempenho operacional da unidade.

  • Supervisionar e coordenar equipes de manutenção mecânica, assegurando a execução segura e eficiente das atividades corretivas, preventivas e preditivas.
  • Planejar e acompanhar intervenções em equipamentos críticos, incluindo sistemas hidráulicos, guindastes offshore, grandes conjuntos rotativos, compressores, bombas, redutores e sistemas auxiliares.
  • Garantir a integridade mecânica de equipamentos de processo, utilidades e apoio, atuando de forma integrada com as áreas de operações, elétrica, instrumentação perfuração e segurança.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento da manutenção de equipamentos de perfuração, tais como top drive, DWS, bombas de lama, sistemas de elevação e circulação, sendo esta experiência considerada um diferencial.
  • Atuar no acompanhamento e manutenção de turbinas (a gás ou vapor), incluindo análise de desempenho, falhas recorrentes e planos de melhoria contínua.
  • Utilizar e manter atualizados sistemas de gestão da manutenção (CMMS/ERP), assegurando a correta abertura, execução e encerramento de ordens de serviço, históricos de falhas e controle de backlog.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar KPIs de Manutenção, tais como disponibilidade física, MTBF, MTTR, aderência ao plano de manutenção, custos e índice de falhas críticas.
  • Participar ativamente da elaboração e revisão dos planos de manutenção, estratégias de confiabilidade e análises de criticidade dos ativos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Apoiar investigações de falhas, análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Gerenciarcontratose atividades de empresas terceirizadas, garantindo conformidade técnica, prazos, qualidade e segurança dos serviços executados.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, promovendotreinamentos, padronização de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção.

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico);

  • Formação técnica ou graduação completa em Mecânica, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de manutenção mecânica em ambiente offshore.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, guindastes e equipamentos rotativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em sistemas de gestão da manutenção e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Experiência com equipamentos de perfuração e/ou turbinas (gás ou vapor) será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas, boas práticas de manutenção e requisitos regulatórios do setor de óleo e gás.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research?

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

Reporting to the Marketing & Communication Director, Life Sciences, you will be the marketing and scientific lead for Brazil. You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and R&D teams, as well as with external partners (agencies, designers, freelancers).

Responsibilities
  • Develop and manage your area: define the marketing strategy with the Marketing Director, Managing Director Brazil, and Heads of Pharma and Cosmetics; plan, implement, and monitor marketing actions and performance.
  • Create scientific and marketing content: translate regulatory and technical information into clear, engaging messages (ICH‑GCP, ANVISA, BE, biosimilars); ensure compliance with local regulations; prepare presentations, technical sheets, brochures, white papers, and scientific articles.
  • Scientific communication: make complex data accessible to varied audiences (sales, clients, conferences).
  • Support the sales team: develop sales tools, training materials, and presentations.
  • Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO‑optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation.
  • Measure ROI: track campaign results and lead conversions with the sales team.
  • Event organization: coordinate participation in conferences and trade shows; build a network of KOLs and strategic partners.
Qualifications
  • MSc (or higher) in Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry); PhD is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B marketing/communication within pharma, biotech, medtech, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong understanding of the drug development process and clinical research.
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish required.
  • Proficiency in content creation and B2B CRM tools; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and regulatory awareness.
Desired Profile
  • Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment.
  • Rigorous and results‑oriented, with strong organizational skills.
  • Creative and forward‑thinking.
  • Curious about scientific and market trends.
  • A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world's trade is carried by sea?

We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonize the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsilä’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Main Responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required Qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • LL.M. degree required.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practicing attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What Success Looks Like In This Role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.
Why join us

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Atuar como referencia corporativa em gestão ambiental, orientando tecnicamente as unidades e indústrias na aplicação dos padrões definidos, de forma a assegurar conformidade legal, consistência operacional e redução de riscos ambientais.

Acompanhar o relatório de sustentabilidade e o desdobramento das metas ambientais corporativas, assegurando consistência das informações, atendimento aos prazos e alinhamento às diretrizes de ESG.

Realizar visitas técnicas periódicas às unidades e bases, conduzindo auditorias, alinhamentos e suporte presencial, com foco na identificação de desvios, orientação técnica e melhoria contínuo dos processos ambientais.

Atuar como responsável técnico ambiental quando formalmente exigido, emitindo ART/RRT conforme atribuições legais da formação e requisitos do organção competente.

Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato para atender às necessídades da área com flexibilidade e proatividade.

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.

  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.

  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.
Core Competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.
Minimum Requirements

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.

description:

Sobre a Função

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação para integrar nossa equipe global de Group Security. A posição reporta-se ao(à) Líder Global de Antifalsificação (ACF) e tem como objetivo liderar a estratégia regional de combate à falsificação, protegendo nossa marca, nossos consumidores e nossa propriedade intelectual.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e com impacto real nos negócios, trabalhando em parceria com equipes internas, autoridades e parceiros externos em diferentes países da região.

Base: Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo

Principais Responsabilidades

Liderança Estratégica

  • Colaborar com áreas internas como negócios, jurídico, assuntos corporativos e comunicação
  • Construir e manter parcerias com autoridades, entidades do setor e stakeholders estratégicos

Execução Operacional

  • Apoiar iniciativas legais relacionadas à falsificação

  • Avaliar resultados e ajustar estratégias quando necessário
  • Trabalhar com equipes de embalagem e negócio na adoção de tecnologias de autenticação de produtos


Engajamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores externos de investigação
  • Desenvolver treinamentos regionais sobre riscos e prevenção à falsificação
  • Representar a Haleon em fóruns, eventos e grupos de trabalho do setor
  • Atuar como referência técnica para stakeholders internos na região


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida (mín. 5 anos) em investigações, proteção de marca, antifalsificação ou enforcement de propriedade intelectual
  • Vivência com autoridades, alfândega e equipes jurídicas em contextos internacionais ou regionais

Competências Essenciais

  • Capacidade de atuar tanto de forma estratégica quanto prática

  • Mentalidade orientada a risco, aprendizado contínuo e melhoria constante
  • Capacidade de colaborar com pessoas de diferentes culturas, países e realidades


About The Role

As part of a global team within Group Security, the Anti-Counterfeit Regional Investigations Manager reports to the Global Lead for Anti-Counterfeiting (ACF). The main function of the role is to tactically develop and implement the ACF strategy, manage and supervise ACF Program investigations and activities in the designated geographic region to include country specific plans. Responsibilities include intelligence assessment, case selection, the management and oversight of anti-counterfeit investigations (online and offline), proactive investigation case management, to include the development and implementation of innovative approaches and investigative strategies to meet business needs.

The manager will collaborate with internal business stakeholders, law enforcement, legal teams, and external partners to drive enforcement actions and strategic initiatives. The role ensures the protection of the company’s intellectual property, brand integrity, and consumer trust by identifying, investigating, and mitigating counterfeit activities.

Location: Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop operational relationships with key internal stakeholders including business, legal, corporate affairs, and corporate communications
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with law enforcement agencies, industry bodies, regulatory authorities, and peer organizations
  • Build and maintain strategic and tactical investigation service supplier relationships, promoting innovation, responsiveness, cost optimization, return on investment (ROI), and continuous improvement
  • Develop KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and return on investment (ROI)
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership and stakeholders


Operational Execution

  • Conduct risk assessments to identify high-risk markets and products
  • Develop and implement regional anti-counterfeit strategies aligned with global brand protection goals
  • Provide instruction and guidance to external investigation suppliers based on the strategic direction set by the Global Program Lead
  • Provide effective case management oversight and direction by working with external investigation suppliers to ensure investigations are conducted and reported efficiently and in accordance with Haleon’s ACF Program Strategy
  • Develop intelligence strategies to identify and monitor counterfeiting trends
  • Oversee regional monitoring of counterfeit activities across online and offline channels
  • Implement a regional customs strategy to identify key strategic ports and counterfeiting routes, product authentication training opportunities, and intelligence dissemination practices
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, customs, regulatory bodies, and industry coalitions to pursue and, when appropriate attend, enforcement actions
  • Ensure ACF Program compliance with international IP laws and regulations
  • Support litigation efforts related to counterfeit activities
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of counterfeit trends and regulatory changes
  • Manage the regional anti-counterfeit program budget, ensuring effective forecasting, spend control, and ROI
  • Monitor and evaluate enforcement outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly
  • Identify and report counterfeiting developments and techniques which undermine product security
  • Work with packaging design and business teams to evaluate and implement product authentication technologies (e.g., serialization, digital watermarking, blockchain).


Stakeholder Engagement and Training

  • Manage relationships with external investigation service suppliers
  • Develop regional training programs to educate stakeholders on counterfeiting risks and mitigation opportunities
  • Represent Haleon at regional industry forums, conferences and working groups to share intelligence, benchmark practices, and influence standards
  • As a subject matter expert, support a regional network of non-ACF champions embedded across business units and functions


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in law enforcement investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, or IP enforcement
  • Experience of working with law enforcement, customs, and legal teams across international jurisdictions
  • Proven experience in investigating and managing complex proactive investigations and enforcements
  • Demonstrated success in managing third-party investigation service suppliers and operational budgets
  • Professional certification such as Interpol Intellectual Property (IP) Crime College or recognized university anti-counterfeit or intellectual property program accreditation strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of IP laws, counterfeit trends, and enforcement mechanisms
  • Exceptional written/oral communication
  • High ethical standards, discretion, and resilience under pressure


Core Competencies

  • Self-motivated and able to act independently and responsibly demonstrating sound and ethical judgment
  • Ability, at both a strategic and tactical level, to identify and manage ACF related issues and customize, implement, and execute solutions
  • Strong commercial acumen and budget/vendor management experience
  • Risk-based thinking and continuous improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Demonstrate ability to work with a wide range of individuals from diverse backgrounds, countries of origin, and at varying levels within the corporate structure


Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

title: MEDICO NEUROLOGISTA - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Descrição da vaga

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia .

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de neurologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde; Diagnosticar doenças e lesões orgânicas do sistema nervoso, realizando exames clínico e subsidiário, para estabelecer o plano terapêutico. Exposição habitual e permanente, não ocasional e nem intermitente, ao risco biológico (Vírus e Bactérias) E Acompanhamento dos pacientes internados;

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, etc;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Preencher adequadamente todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência;
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa);
  • Acompanhamento dos pacientes internados;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição
Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação completa em Medicina;

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Neurologia/ Parkinson;

Registro ativo no CRM;

Informações adicionais

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Escala: 10h e 20h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Supervisão de Comunicação e Experiência da Marca
description:
Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Quais serão seus desafios:

  • Planejar, estruturar e executar réguas de comunicação para campanhas de incentivo, garantindo consistência, frequência e engajamento ao longo de toda a jornada;

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar a experiência da marca em todos os pontos de contato com o público interno e parceiros;
  • Realizar negociação e gestão de parcerias estratégicas (fornecedores, agências e stakeholders internos);
  • Supervisionar a operação da loja corporativa MAG Presente, incluindo curadoria, logística, performance e experiência do usuário;
  • Gerenciar projetos simultâneos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade das entregas;
  • Liderar e desenvolver o time, promovendo organização, autonomia e alta performance;
  • Atuar como elo entre áreas internas (comercial, comunicação, operações) e parceiros externos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e propor melhorias contínuas nas iniciativas de experiência e engajamento.
Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em marketing, experiência de marca, trade marketing ou campanhas de incentivo.
  • Vivência com réguas de comunicação (CRM, jornadas, campanhas multicanal).
  • Experiência em negociação com fornecedores e gestão de parcerias.
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de projetos e pessoas.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de influência.
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a resultados e execução.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com lojas corporativas, programas de incentivo ou plataformas de premiação.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Garantir a execução da estratégia da nova plataforma de vídeos verticais da Globo, maximizando valor para usuários, anunciantes e produtores de conteúdo, por meio de decisões orientadas a dados, excelência em experiência e forte articulação com áreas especialistas;
  • Equilibrar crescimento de audiência, experiência do usuário, eficiência de monetização e otimização de custos em um ambiente de múltiplos stakeholders. Influenciar times especialistas que atuam em múltiplos produtos, sem gestão direta. Garantir clareza estratégica e velocidade de execução em produtos de alta exposição e relevância. Manter os produtos atualizados frente às rápidas transformações do mercado de entretenimento digital;
  • Executar a estratégia do produto sob a ótica de negócio, marca e experiência, garantindo coerência com os objetivos estratégicos;
  • Ser responsável pelo desempenho financeiro, atuando junto às áreas comercial e financeira na identificação de oportunidades de monetização, eficiência de custo e otimização de margem;
  • Monitorar indicadores-chave da plataforma, identificando riscos, perdas de desempenho e oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Atuar como especialista da experiência do produto, sendo referência nos fluxos de navegação, pontos de fricção, diferenciais competitivos e oportunidades de evolução;
  • Garantir o alinhamento do backlog de produto aos objetivos estratégicos do produto;
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de marca e posicionamento dos produtos, tanto para o público consumidor quanto para o mercado anunciante;
  • Acompanhar tendências de consumo de entretenimento digital, pesquisas de comportamento e movimentações de mercado;
  • Monitorar iniciativas de concorrentes e benchmarks, analisando resultados e propondo planos de resposta ou adaptação estratégica;
  • Gerir diretamente o times dedicado ao produto;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com os líderes de Tecnologia, Marketing, Conteúdo, Inteligência e Comercial;
  • Articular parcerias estratégicas que contribuam para crescimento, inovação e fortalecimento do produto.
Requisitos e qualificações

Do que você precisa:

  • Experiência prévia com Produtos Digitais: buscamos alguém com experiência prévia de atuação direta em produtos digitais. Precisa ser uma pessoa com familiaridade com arquitetura de produto, priorização de backlog de desenvolvimento, mecânica de recomendação e arquitetura de dados;

  • Visão estratégica de produto, com capacidade de traduzir objetivos de negócio em decisões claras de produto. Experiência em priorização, acompanhamento e análise de iniciativas de produto;
  • Conhecimentos sobre Experiência do Usuário (UX) e arquitetura de produto: domínio de fluxos, navegação e diferenciação entre plataformas;
  • Visão analítica, orientada a dados e centrada no usuário para tomada de decisão;
  • Compreensão de modelos de monetização de plataformas e produtos digitais, com foco em publicidade;
  • Boa capacidade de organização, priorização e comunicação com stakeholders.

Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals.
